annotations.text: The problem, measured on the real app at 390x844: 13 floating boxes in 5 clusters. Only 16.5% of the screen is covered - the trouble is scatter, not coverage.
Proposed world HUD. Three docks: status (top), tools (right), actions (bottom). Every colour and size lifted from css/styles.css - this reorganises, it does not repaint.
Proposed minigame HUD. Today the title and the controls each appear twice in two stacked bars; here it is one header, one tab row, one control bar - and Run is the only primary.
The rules that make it hold together as the game grows: where things dock, what each colour is allowed to mean, and what each button shape promises.
